'''Cardooine''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Jospro sector/Legends|Jospro sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]].
It was where the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] built [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|A-wings]] used in the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]. It was also the home of [[Fijisi]] wood, used in sections of the [[Imperial Palace/Legends|Imperial Palace]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and other high-class buildings. Less pleasantly, the disease [[Cardooine Chills]] also originated on this planet.

In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="Date">The [[Takeover at Whisper Base (adventure)|''Takeover at Whisper Base'']] Adventure notes that the roleplaying campaign [[Takeover at Whisper Base|mission]] occurs just after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] and that the characters were recently recruited.</ref> there was a [[Rebel base (Cardooine)|Rebel base]] on the planet which hosted the prototype A-wings. The squadron [[Soaring Dactillions]] was assigned there to test the starfighters. After a [[Standard week/Legends|week]], the base was [[Assault on Cardooine|assaulted]] by the Empire. Although the squadron defended the base, only two pilots survived.<ref name="Zal">[[Takeover at Whisper Base (adventure)|''Takeover at Whisper Base (Adventure Book)'']] Zal Ace Character Folio</ref>
